name: @jafshare/browser-mcp

tools.name: browser_getPageInfo
tools.description: Get information about current page (URL, title, metadata)

tabId.description: Tab ID (optional, defaults to active tab)

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of current page or a specific element. Default format: jpeg (reduced file size for faster transmission)

selector.description: CSS selector for element to capture

format.description: Image format (default: jpeg for reduced file size)

quality.description: Image quality (1-100, default: 75 for balanced size/quality)

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element on the page. Supports two methods: 1) nodeId (recommended): Uses Chrome Debugger API for real mouse simulation - more reliable and bypasses bot detection. Get nodeId from browser_getContent with format='axTree'. 2) selector: CSS selector - uses JavaScript event simulation. Provide either nodeId or selector.

selector.description: CSS selector for element to click

nodeId.description: AX node ID (format: 'ax-123') for element to click - uses Chrome Debugger API for real mouse simulation

waitFor.description: Timeout in milliseconds (only used with selector)

tools.name: browser_input
tools.description: Input text into a form field. Supports two methods: 1) nodeId (recommended): Uses Chrome Debugger API for real keyboard simulation - more reliable and bypasses bot detection. Get nodeId from browser_getContent with format='axTree'. 2) selector: CSS selector - uses JavaScript event simulation. Provide either nodeId or selector.

nodeId.description: AX node ID (format: 'ax-123') for input element - uses Chrome Debugger API for real typing simulation

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll page or a specific element

selector.description: CSS selector for element to scroll

tools.name: browser_getContent
tools.description: Extract content from page or a specific element. Supports text/html/markdown/axTree formats. Markdown uses dom-to-semantic-markdown for LLM-optimized semantic structure. AX Tree uses Chrome DevTools Protocol Accessibility Tree - provides nodeId for reliable element interaction with browser_click/browser_input (recommended for AI interaction). Optional Mozilla Readability for cleaner content extraction.

format.description: Content format: 'text' for visible text, 'html' for HTML markup, 'markdown' for semantic Markdown (optimized for LLMs), 'axTree' for Accessibility Tree JSON (for AI interaction)

readability.description: Use Mozilla Readability to extract main content (filters nav/ads/footer)

close.description: Close the tab after getting content

tools.name: browser_waitForSelector
tools.description: Wait for an element to appear on page

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a new URL. Supports four targeting modes: 1) No target: Navigates the active tab in the current window. 2) windowId: Navigates the active tab in the specified window. 3) tabId: Navigates the specific tab (takes precedence over windowId). 4) newWindow: Opens URL in a new window (takes highest precedence).

windowId.description: Window ID to navigate in (optional, defaults to current active window)

tabId.description: Tab ID to navigate in (optional, takes precedence over windowId if specified)

newWindow.description: Open URL in a new window (optional, defaults to false)

tools.name: browser_getAllTabs
tools.description: Get information about all open tabs across all windows

windowId.description: Filter by window ID (optional, omit for all windows)

currentWindow.description: Filter for tabs in current window only (optional)

tools.name: browser_getAllWindows
tools.description: Get information about all open windows with their tabs. Uses chrome.windows.getAll with populate option for efficient data retrieval.

populate.description: Include tab information for each window (optional, defaults to true)

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close tabs and/or windows by their IDs. Supports batch closing multiple tabs and windows in a single call. Close windows first for efficiency (tabs inside are auto-closed).

tabIds.description: Array of tab IDs to close

windowIds.description: Array of window IDs to close
